text: ポケモンリーグへ　いどむ　きみへ　せんべつだ！
note: せんべつ (餞別) is a Japanese custom: a farewell gift, often money, given to someone setting off on a journey, moving away or leaving a job. The English "gift" loses this send-off sense.
claim: Senbetsu (餞別) is a Japanese farewell gift given to someone who is leaving on a trip, moving away or changing jobs.

check.quote: A gift, typically money in an envelope, given to someone who is moving away, transferring to another workplace, or embarking on a long journey.
